title: Uninvited Guest
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Nian placed the fragment beside Chen Ji's Turtle Shell, the two faint lights faintly resonated—this was by no means coincidence, but a bond predestined in the depths of their bloodline.

text.content: At the third quarter of the midnight hour, the lights in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters had long been extinguished. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the dilapidated wooden bed, eyes lowered, as if he had long fallen into slumber. Yet his divine sense spread like a spider's web, enveloping the entire courtyard. For three years, he had never truly slept a peaceful night—the cost of the Tianji Record Fragment was too high; every act of foresight brought him closer to that inevitable backlash, so he had to remain vigilant at all times. Tonight's wind carried the coolness of early autumn, brushing past the window lattice with a faint whimper. Within that wind, Chen Ji's divine sense suddenly caught a barely perceptible disturbance—someone was approaching his room, and that aura... bore a bizarre resonance with his bloodline.

dialogue.content: (Pushing open the door, her figure appearing delicate and pale in the moonlight) Brother, it's me.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes slowly opened, revealing not the slightest hint of surprise, as if he had long anticipated this moment. By the faint moonlight filtering through the window, he clearly saw the visitor's face—thin and gaunt, with stubborn brows, seemingly a completely different person from the little girl with twin bun hairstyle in his memory, yet bearing an inexplicable resemblance. Chen Nian. His own sister, taken by the Holy Sect to serve as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock.' Three years had passed, yet she was still alive, and had found her way here. Chen Ji's heart surged with immense waves, yet his expression remained placid, even carrying a hint of a lazy smile at the corner of his mouth.

dialogue.content: (Not rising, not lighting a lamp, leisurely adjusting his robe) Breaking into someone's chambers in the dead of night—if it were anyone else, I would have reported you to the Law Enforcement Hall long ago. You certainly chose an opportune time.

(Sitting down across from Chen Ji with grave expression) Brother, I know you have many questions. But I have no time to explain—the Holy Sect has already detected my whereabouts. I've come to tell you something... a secret concerning our bloodline.

choice.prompt: Faced with Chen Nian's sudden appearance and talk of 'bloodline secrets,' Chen Ji needed to decide what attitude to adopt—whether to directly probe her depths, maintain passive observation, or take the initiative to disrupt her rhythm?

choices.description: Show no urgency whatsoever, letting Chen Nian reveal information on her own while顺势 observing all her reactions and flaws.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to take the lead
choices.visible_reward: Gain more information, initiative remains in hand
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian has ulterior motives, she may lead him by the nose
choices.process_label: 陈机选择沉默，给对方施压的空间

dialogue.content: (Fingers gently tapping the bedside, the rhythm unhurried) Bloodline secrets... interesting. Then tell me, where does this secret originate, and why tell me tonight of all nights?

choices.text: Direct confrontation, strike at the要害
choices.description: Directly point out her identity as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock,' and why the Holy Sect is hunting her, forcing her to lay her cards on the table.
choices.risk_hint: If what she says has hidden motives, may miss the truth
choices.process_label: 陈机选择先发制人，打破对方的叙事节奏

dialogue.content: (The smile at the corner of his mouth deepens, yet his eyes remain icy cold) Heavenly Fate Lock... A chess piece the Holy Sect went to great lengths to cultivate, how has it become a stray dog? Speak—did you come to me on the Holy Sect's orders, or are you defecting from your sect on your own?

choices.description: Raise no利害 relations, only ask how she has been these years, probing her true intentions as a brother.
choices.visible_reward: May awaken her true feelings, thereby revealing more key information
choices.risk_hint: If she has completely turned dark, the emotional card may be useless
choices.process_label: 陈机选择以情动人，展现温情一面

dialogue.content: (After a long silence, his tone gaining a rare hint of gentleness) ...Have you been well these years? When the Holy Sect people took you away, I swore I would find you. But I was too weak, unable to do anything.

(Her gaze stirs slightly, seemingly touched by something, but quickly recovers composure) Brother, you've changed. The old you wouldn't say such things... Never mind, we'll discuss this later. I came here because I discovered something—the Turtle Shell on your body is no ordinary item. I have a fragment with me, and it... is a pair with yours.

text.content: This sentence struck like thunder in Chen Ji's heart lake. His Tianji Record Fragment was entrusted to him by his master Chen Xuan on his deathbed, said to be a relic left by an ancient prophet. He had never imagined the Turtle Shell could have another half—and in Chen Nian's possession. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, but the next second he regained composure. He lowered his gaze to his right hand, where he held that warm Turtle Shell. For three years, this item had never left his side; every act of foresight into the future consumed his precious 'Heavenly Fate Value.' If there truly was another half... what did that mean?

choice.prompt: Chen Nian revealed the Turtle Shell's secret, and Chen Ji needed to choose between displaying the Turtle Shell and hiding his trump card—this concerned the core leverage of his three-year plan.

choices.text: Reveal trump card, display Turtle Shell
choices.description: Take out the Turtle Shell, observe Chen Nian's reaction and whether the claimed 'resonance' is true, while judging her true intentions.
choices.visible_reward: Verify the truth of Chen Nian's words, may discover new abilities of the Turtle Shell
choices.risk_hint: If she takes this opportunity to seize the treasure or set a trap, there will be no way out
choices.process_label: 陈机决定冒险验证，但保持随时收回的姿态

dialogue.content: (Slowly spreading open his palm, the ancient Turtle Shell radiating a faint glow in the moonlight) Is this what you mean? For three years, it has never left my side. If you truly have another half... show me.

choices.text: Guard trump card, let her reveal first
choices.description: Claim the Turtle Shell was lost long ago, instead ask Chen Nian to show her fragment first,以此试探她的诚意与情报.
choices.visible_reward: Not expose core trump card, while gaining more information
choices.risk_hint: If she leaves because of this, will miss the chance to verify
choices.process_label: 陈机决定说谎，以此观察对方的反应

dialogue.content: (Expression unchanged, withdrawing right hand into sleeve) Turtle Shell? That thing you speak of, I lost it three years ago. Perhaps... that 'thing' you mention isn't even here. Are you sure you haven't found the wrong person?

choices.text: Change topic, inquire about Holy Sect movements
choices.description: Not respond to the Turtle Shell matter, instead ask why the Holy Sect is hunting her and the real reason for her defection, to first clarify the enemy situation.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Holy Sect internal intelligence, providing reference for subsequent plans
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may lose patience and leave in anger
choices.process_label: 陈机选择暂不深究，先摸清敌人的底牌

dialogue.content: (Laughing lightly, noncommittal) Interesting. But what I want to know more is—why would the Holy Sect hunt a 'Heavenly Fate Lock'? Did you lose your value of use, or... did you learn something you shouldn't have?

(Gaze sharp, seemingly seeing through Chen Ji's thoughts) Brother, you needn't probe me. The Holy Sect hunts me because I discovered a truth they desperately want to conceal—the Tianji Record is not some ancient relic, but... (lowering voice) a bloodline artifact亲手 forged by our Chen family's ancestors. You and I,才是它真正的主人.

text.content: Chen family ancestors. Chen Ji's heart suddenly clenched. He had never heard his master Chen Xuan mention this connection. Mo Xiansheng—that residual soul guardian dwelling on the first page of the Tianji Record—had also never revealed a single word. If Chen Nian spoke truth, then all his plans and calculations over these three years were built upon a massive lie. Who was his master Chen Xuan really? Why give him this Turtle Shell? And why selectively conceal these key pieces of information? Countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind at lightning speed, yet his expression remained as unruffled as an ancient well. Three years of playing the pig to eat the tiger had long taught him how to maintain superficial calm amidst tumultuous waves.

dialogue.content: (Finally showing a hint of earnestness, slowly speaking) Tell me then, who were our Chen family ancestors? How could they forge such a heaven-defying object? If you can't explain, I'll consider it rambling.
(Slowly withdrawing a Turtle Shell Fragment from her怀, its shape, size, and纹路竟与陈机的那枚如出一辙) This I stole from the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds. Brother, look... can these two pieces join together?

text.content: In the moonlight, the two Turtle Shells radiated a faint glow. Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly—not from fear, but from some stirring in the depths of his bloodline. He could clearly sense that the fragment was calling to his chest's Turtle Shell, like loved ones separated for years finally reunited. He took a deep breath,取出自己的龟甲，两相对照。当它们相距不足三寸时，一股温热的气息从掌心传来，两枚龟甲竟开始微微震颤，发出只有陈机与陈念能够听到的低鸣。这一刻，陈机终于意识到——他不是天机录的偶然继承者，而是……命中注定的传承者。而这个真相，可能将彻底颠覆他三年来的所有布局。

choice.prompt: The two Turtle Shells resonated, and Chen Ji faced a final choice—whether to hand over his Turtle Shell to unite them, or retain his trump card to observe the situation?

choices.description: Combine the Turtle Shell with Chen Nian's Fragment, officially begin the path of bloodline awakening, even if it means breaking existing plans without hesitation.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record may evolve, unlock complete abilities
choices.process_label: 陈机决定赌上一切，迎接命运

dialogue.content: (Taking a deep breath, extending the Turtle Shell toward Chen Nian) ...Since heaven's will is thus, I have nothing to fear. Nian'er, let's combine them.

choices.description: 收起龟甲，表示需要时间验证陈念所言，同时暗中计划找墨先生求证。
choices.visible_reward: 保住现有能力，为验证争取时间
choices.risk_hint: 若陈念所言属实，可能错失最佳时机
choices.process_label: 陈机决定不急于做决定，保持现状

dialogue.content: (将龟甲收回袖中，神色复杂)你说的这些，我需要时间消化。此事干系重大，容我先验证一二。你若真是我妹妹，这些年受的苦，我陈机必会加倍讨回来。

choices.description: 让陈念展示只有陈家人知道的信物或往事，以此验证她是否真是失散多年的妹妹，而非圣宗的陷阱。
choices.visible_reward: 确保不会落入敌人圈套
choices.risk_hint: 陈念可能因不被信任而心寒
choices.process_label: 陈机决定先验明正身，再做打算

dialogue.content: (后退一步，眼神转冷)空口白话，谁都会说。你若真是念儿，可还记得我们小时候的事？父亲教给我们的第一句话是什么？
(苦涩一笑，眼中闪过一丝追忆)父亲说的第一句话……是「机儿，念儿，你们是天的弃子，也是地的宠儿。天弃我，我不怨；地宠我，我必报。」哥，这句话……你还记得吗？

text.content: 这句话如同一把钥匙，打开了陈机尘封已久的记忆闸门。他想起来了——那是父亲临终前的最后一句话。那时的他还年幼，不懂这句话的含义，只觉得父亲的手很凉、声音很轻。后来他被师父陈玄收养，再后来师父也死了，他独自一人在这天青宗的最底层挣扎求存，从未忘记过父亲的话。天的弃子，地的宠儿……原来，从一开始，他和陈念就不是普通人。陈机缓缓闭上眼睛，将翻涌的情绪压回心底。再睁眼时，那双眸子里已是一片深不见底的平静。

Chen Ji's lips moved slightly, yet ultimately no words emerged. He slowly withdrew the Turtle Shell that had accompanied him for three years from his sleeve; in the moonlight, its纹路与陈念手中的残片如镜像般对应。当两枚龟甲逐渐靠近时，陈机感到掌心传来一阵灼热——那是血脉深处涌动的力量，陌生却又熟悉得可怕。三年来他小心翼翼隐藏的底牌，此刻正在命运之手的推动下缓缓揭开面纱。他知道，无论今夜做出何种选择，他的人生都将彻底改变。子时的钟声从远处隐约传来，陈念焦急的目光与他对视，那里面藏着太多他还未曾了解的秘密与苦难。
(沉默良久，终于开口，声音低沉而沙哑)这句话……我记得。念儿，这些年，苦了你了。（将龟甲轻轻放在掌心，凝视着那道微微发光的裂痕）既然天意如此，那我便没什么好犹豫的。来吧，让我们看看，这天机录的另一半……究竟藏着什么秘密。

当两枚龟甲终于合为一体的刹那，一道耀眼的白光从陈机的胸口迸发而出，将整间小屋照得如同白昼。陈机感到天旋地转，无数陌生的画面如潮水般涌入脑海——他看见了一个陌生的男子身着古装、手持龟甲，在九天之上与一道巨大的意志对峙；他看见了无尽的鲜血与尸骨，还有那句如同诅咒般的低语：「天机不可泄，泄者必遭焚……」当光芒散去，陈机猛然惊醒，发现自己的鼻间正缓缓流淌下一缕鲜血。而陈念的脸色同样苍白如纸，显然也承受了某种巨大的反噬。两枚龟甲已经彻底融为一体，静静躺在他们之间的木桌上，散发着诡异的微光——那光芒似乎在诉说着一个被掩盖了千年的惊天秘密。
